value.rationale: The equality b+c=3a+1/2 is the mathematically forced boundary between strict algebraic/oscillatory regimes studied in Proposition 5.1. The result produces a sharp |R|=1 phase divider (away from coalescence), simple cofinite root strings, exact off-axis asymptotic heights and positive-real density. These are structural classifications for a natural full-parameter family, not arbitrary finite tests; the border and bounded exceptions are honestly excluded.
